method: Executed static auditor, official Khronos validator, saved source/export comparison and independently launched bounded local macOS rebuild with hash-bound request/result. Compared exact r12/r15 woody vertex, face and world-matrix arrays.
observations: Source/export triangles and axis-converted bounds agree.
Separate-process rebuild is byte-identical and semantically identical.
r12 and r15 woody vertices, face indices and world matrix are exactly equal.
No texture, no external resources, three opaque primitives.

warning_review.rationale: Shared smooth normals are explicitly intentional for the shallow closed leaf-group mesh to reduce per-face export duplication. Physical depth stays 13% of width; woody planes are flat. Maker inspected current 512px color/clay pixels. This is a technical warning explanation, not independent style acceptance.
